spans.s: paunarbhavika, f. ˚kā or ˚kī, adj. (also punar˚, q.v.; = Pali ponobbhavika; to Skt. punar-bhava plus ika), pertaining to rebirth: of tṛṣṇā, ˚kā Mv 〔iii.332.6〕; ˚kī LV 〔417.8〕; Laṅk 〔138.11—12〕; 〔162.15〕; of masc. nouns, (… paridāghā …) ˚kā(ḥ) Mv 〔iii.338.4, 9〕 (in both v.l. punar˚), 11; (akuśalair dharmaiḥ) … ˚kaiḥ Av 〔ii.107.3〕; Bbh 〔182.27〕.
